source: MCP tool descriptions, required scopes, annotations, and operation categories.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Identify the single workspace bound to the bearer credential. This is read-only and requires no additional Workspace API scope.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products by lifecycle status with bounded cursor pagination. The API does not provide fuzzy product search. Requires catalog:read.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its stable ID. Read-only; requires catalog:read.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: List materials by lifecycle status with bounded cursor pagination. The API does not provide fuzzy material search. Requires catalog:read.

tools.name: get_material
tools.description: Get one material by its stable ID. Read-only; requires catalog:read.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List workspace inventory locations with cursor pagination. Requires locations:read.

tools.name: list_lots
tools.description: List traceable lots, optionally filtered by item or supplier, with cursor pagination. Requires inventory:read.

tools.name: get_inventory_stock
tools.description: Get authoritative stock on hand for a product or material, optionally at a location or lot. This does not calculate stock in MCP. Requires inventory:read.

tools.name: list_inventory_movements
tools.description: List inventory ledger movements using supported item, location, lot, or exact reason filters. Read-only; requires inventory:read.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search suppliers by the API's name/email text query, optionally including archived records. Read-only; requires suppliers:read.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by its stable ID. Read-only; requires suppliers:read.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders using supported text, status, and supplier filters with cursor pagination. Read-only; requires purchasing:read.

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get a purchase order with independently bounded lines, overheads, and receipts. Pass each returned nested cursor to continue that collection. Requires purchasing:read.

tools.name: list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders using supported status, customer, and source filters with cursor pagination. Read-only; requires sales:read.

tools.name: get_sales_order
tools.description: Get a sales order with independently bounded lines and fulfillments. Pass returned nested cursors to continue either collection. Requires sales:read.

tools.name: get_bom
tools.description: Get one bounded page of flat BOM lines for a product. Use next_cursor to continue; MCP does not reconstruct manufacturing logic. Requires manufacturing:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: preview_bom_cost
tools.description: Ask Fabriqo to calculate estimated material cost for a product and quantity. Read-only; requires manufacturing:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: list_production_runs
tools.description: List production runs by status with bounded cursor pagination. Read-only; requires manufacturing:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: get_production_run
tools.description: Get a production run and a bounded page of receipts. Use next_receipt_cursor to continue. Read-only; requires manufacturing:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: get_production_run_costing
tools.description: Get Fabriqo's authoritative costing for one production run. Read-only; requires reports:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: get_production_forecast
tools.description: Get a bounded production-demand forecast for a 1-365 day horizon. Read-only; requires reports:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: get_recall_readiness
tools.description: Get aggregate lot traceability coverage and recall-readiness metrics. Read-only; requires reports:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: trace_lot
tools.description: Trace one lot through bounded movement, production-link, and sales-order collections. Each nested collection has its own cursor. Read-only; requires traceability:read and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a product in the authenticated workspace. This changes workspace state, requires catalog:write, respects catalog plan limits, and uses a Workspace API idempotency key.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update supported fields on one product. This changes workspace state and requires catalog:write; repeating the same patch is safe.

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Create a material in the authenticated workspace. This changes workspace state, requires catalog:write, respects catalog plan limits, and uses a Workspace API idempotency key.

tools.name: update_material
tools.description: Update supported fields on one material, including its default supplier. This changes workspace state and requires catalog:write; repeating the same patch is safe.

tools.name: create_supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier in the authenticated workspace. This changes workspace state, requires suppliers:write, and uses a Workspace API idempotency key.

tools.name: update_supplier
tools.description: Update supported fields on one supplier. This changes workspace state and requires suppliers:write; repeating the same patch is safe.

tools.name: create_location
tools.description: Create an inventory location in the authenticated workspace. This changes workspace state, requires locations:write, respects plan limits, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: update_location
tools.description: Rename one inventory location. This changes workspace state and requires locations:write; repeating the same patch is safe.

tools.name: set_default_location
tools.description: Make one inventory location the workspace default. This changes workspace state, requires locations:write and the multi-location plan capability; repeating it is safe.

tools.name: create_barcode
tools.description: Create a barcode for a product or material. This changes workspace state, requires catalog:write, and uses an idempotency key; a primary barcode replaces that item's current primary designation.

tools.name: add_bom_component
tools.description: Add a material component to a product's flat BOM. This changes workspace state, requires manufacturing:write and the Manufacturing solution entitlement, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: update_bom_component
tools.description: Update quantity or scrappage on one flat BOM component. This changes workspace state, requires manufacturing:write and the Manufacturing solution entitlement; repeating the same patch is safe.

tools.name: remove_bom_component
tools.description: Remove one material component from a product's flat BOM. This destructive operation changes workspace state and requires manufacturing:write and the Manufacturing solution entitlement.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.description: Create a purchase order. This changes workspace state, requires purchasing:write, and uses a Workspace API idempotency key.

tools.name: mark_purchase_order_ordered
tools.description: Mark a draft purchase order as ordered. This changes workspace state and requires purchasing:write; repeating it is safe.

tools.name: receive_purchase_order
tools.description: Receive explicit quantities against purchase-order lines. This changes inventory and order state, requires purchasing:write, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: create_sales_order
tools.description: Create a sales order with explicit product lines and business date. This changes workspace state, requires sales:write, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: fulfill_sales_order
tools.description: Fulfill explicit sales-order line quantities from a location. This changes inventory and order state, requires sales:write, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: create_production_run
tools.description: Create a production run for a product and planned quantity. This changes workspace state, requires manufacturing:write and the Manufacturing solution entitlement, and uses an idempotency key.

tools.name: record_production_receipt
tools.description: Record produced and/or scrap quantity for a production run. This consumes/creates inventory, requires manufacturing:write and the Manufacturing solution entitlement, and uses an idempotency key. At least one quantity must be greater than zero.

tools.name: transfer_inventory
tools.description: Transfer an item quantity between two workspace locations. This changes inventory, requires inventory:write and the workspace transfers capability, and uses an idempotency key. Source and destination locations must differ.

tools.name: adjust_inventory
tools.description: Post an explicit non-zero inventory adjustment at a location. This changes inventory, requires inventory:write, and uses an idempotency key.
